text:
nina: Quick alert — vendor-galaxy reports an unexpected customs reclassification at Port D. H100 EU ETA drifting from ~6d -> ~13d. This will affect Dedicated EU pool ahead of the tenant onboarding.

vendor-galaxy: Confirmed. Root cause: customs reclass on a subset of BLs + terminal dwell. Options we can execute fast: 1) airbridge via FRA (consolidated broker) for up to 18 units, ETA ~48-72h, expedite surcharge $2.75k/unit; 2) full sea roster (no surcharge) ETA 12-14d; 3) temporary loaner pool under an MOU (we can provision 14 loaners within 3d) fee $550/unit, must sign CLA. We can include preprinted RMA return labels, crate QR + optional NFC tag for scan trace if you sign the amendment. Depot burn-in observed ~0.45% last wave.

maya: @vendor-galaxy please attach: updated ETA spreadsheet, serial manifest CSV, crate QR spec, NFC payload example, and a sample depot photo checklist. We need a manifest checksum so our ingestion verifies integrity.

vendor-galaxy: Will upload manifest + checksum (sha256) + photo checklist in 90m. NFC payload example: {po,crate_id,manifest_sha256}. RMA label format: GALAXY_{depot}_{po}_{serial}.

sam: Short calc: airbridge 18 * 2750 = 49,500. Loaners 14 * 550 = 7,700 + handling. If launch requires +30 GPUs by D+5 and EU slack = 11, then air 18 -> slack 29 (short 1). Combine loaners +14 -> slack 43 -> safe. But loaners are temporary.

```
air_cost = 18 * 2750 = 49500
loaner_cost = 14 * 550 = 7700
total_delta = 57200
```

sam: is missing launch tolerable? if not, air+loaners looks necessary.

arjun: Ops note: we can free 5 GPUs in FRA staging by reimaging but cross-dc reassignments to EU central take ~7-9d. NFC crate tags would help depot matching and speed intake.

ops-eu: please ensure vendor commits to: 1) manifest CSV within 2h of pickup; 2) crate photos uploaded to our S3 webhook <=24h; 3) NFC scan payload present on arrival. Depot will refuse warranty intake without photo+manifest match.

nina: Prioritize the onboarding SLA. @procurement-bot open PO amendment with two paths: (A) sign airbridge for 18 + 2 spares/100 and loaner MOU for 14 units; (B) fallback full ocean. Include clauses: crate QR on exterior, optional NFC in each crate, RMA labels in-box, manifest sha256 in header, depot photos <=24h, RMA pickup window <=72h, and vendor must include pickup_ticket id in manifest. Tag finance for one-off expedite.

procurement-bot: Created PO 99888_amendment. Draft includes airbridge path + loaner MOU option, spare clause, and photo/manifest SLAs. Routing to @finance and procurement-team for approval.

vendor-galaxy: Addendum: if you sign amendment we will attach pre-paid RMA pickup stickers and a crate-level NFC sticker preprogrammed with the manifest sha256. Also we can include 3 spares per 150 units at no extra freight, or a pro-rata spare credit.

maya: Agree to spares and NFC. Add CSV schema requirement: columns = serial, sku, shipped_ts, depot_id, crate_id, manifest_sha256, photo_sha256, burnin_flag, pickup_ticket. Also require vendor to add a crate-level note in the manifest if any burn-in observed during pack.

sam: I approve airbridge 18 + loaner MOU + spares as proposed, contingent on finance sign-off. Please include cost center allocation and expected invoice.

finance: One-off expedite approved under code 4377 up to $60k. Please route final invoice and include ledger lines.

vendor-galaxy: Confirmed. Air AWB: GX-FRA-180 (ETA 48-72h). Loaner MOU draft uploaded: loaner_mou_99888.pdf. Manifest uploaded: manifest_1807654321.csv + manifest_1807654321.sha256. Crate photo checklist and NFC sample included.

ops-eu: We'll stand up the photo webhook endpoint and validate sha256 on ingestion. Please ensure vendor photos are stamped with crate_id metadata so we can match. We'll also prep depot contacts for 24h SLA and RMA pickup staging.

tara: Ops request: add an acceptance clause that depot must upload initial crate photos within 8h for first 2 crates (pilot) so we can validate the NFC/QR workflow. If pilot fails, revert to standard 24h SLA.

nina: Good call. @procurement-bot add pilot clause (2 crates, 8h photo SLA) to amendment and note rollback criteria.

procurement-bot: Amendment updated with pilot clause. Awaiting vendor signature and procurement approval.

vendor-galaxy: Signing in progress. We will also include a post-arrival report with burn-in stats and RMA pickup ids for each crate within 7 days.

nina: Thanks all. Once invoice is validated procurement-bot mark PO amended and vendor confirmed. After arrival ops post crate-level RMA burn-in and pickup ids to this thread for post-mortem.

procurement-bot: PO 99888_amendment -> awaiting vendor signature -> finance tagged -> thread will be archived for 45d after close.

sam: cheers. Keep RMA numbers and pilot photo timing front-and-center so we can decide whether NFC+spare policy improves intake speed and reduces warranty rejects.
